Michael.text: On your turn: Discard a card from another player's Choir, then discard this card.
Michael.why: Spent: use it, then discard it (V42)

Gabriel.text: On your turn: Look at another player's hand.
Gabriel.why: The Base game has no Event deck (V42)

Providence.text: At the end of each Day your Choir leans with the Tide, put 1 Glory from the Pot on this card. On your turn: You may take all the Glory on it, then discard this card.
Providence.cadence: At the end of the Day
Providence.why: A store: an engine that grows (V42)

Tree of Life.text: At the end of the Day: You may take a card from the Altar into your Choir. If your Choir is full, discard one of its cards first.
Tree of Life.cadence: At the end of the Day

Free Will.text: On your turn: Take a second action, then discard this card.

Seraphim.text: When you Exalt a Light card, gain 1 Glory.
Seraphim.why: Exalt is free (V42): rewards building a Light Choir

Uriel.text: At the end of the Day: If your Choir has 3 or more other Light cards, gain 2 Glory.
Uriel.cadence: At the end of the Day

Martyr.text: At the end of the Day: If you lost Glory at the Reaping, you may replace a card in your Choir with a card from your hand.
Martyr.cadence: At the end of the Day

Covenant.text: In the Morning: You may name another player. If neither of you Offers this Day, each of you gains 1 Glory.
Covenant.why: Simpler pact, made in the Morning (V42)

Mercy.text: If yours is the only Choir against the Tide, lose 1 instead of 3, then discard this card.
Mercy.why: Spent; spares the lone loser under mirrored scoring (V42)

Revelation.text: On your turn: Flip a facedown Altar card face up. You may then flip a face-up Altar card facedown.
Revelation.why: Ithuriel's ability, with art; one deck for every mode (V42)

Morning Star.text: On your turn: Choose a card in your Choir. It counts as the opposite alignment this Day.

Knowledge.text: On your turn: Secretly look at up to 3 facedown Altar cards.
Knowledge.why: Urim's ability, with art; one deck for every mode (V42)

Deliverance.text: On your turn: Swap a card between any two players' Choirs, then discard this card.

Remnant.text: At the end of the Day: You may take back a card you Offered today into your hand.
Remnant.cadence: At the end of the Day

Anathema.text: On your turn: No other player may Offer until the start of your next turn.

Favor.text: At the end of each Day your Choir leans with the Tide, put 1 Glory on this card. When it holds 3, remove them and gain 2 Glory.
Favor.cadence: At the end of the Day

Temptation.text: On your turn: Play a card from your hand into another player's Choir. If their Choir is full, they discard one of its cards first.
Temptation.why: Builds a rival's Choir: pull them onto or off a side (V42)

Legion.text: When you Exalt a Dark card, gain 1 Glory.

Beelzebub.text: At the end of the Day: If your Choir has 3 or more other Dark cards, gain 2 Glory.
Beelzebub.cadence: At the end of the Day

Leviathan.text: At the end of the Day: If 2 or more other players lost Glory this Day, gain 1 Glory.
Leviathan.cadence: At the end of the Day

Hubris.text: At the end of the Day: If the player with the most Glory gained 4 or more Glory this Day, they give 1 to you.
Hubris.cadence: At the end of the Day

Belial.text: On your turn: Look at a facedown Altar card. You may swap it with a card from your hand.
Belial.why: Asmadai's ability, with art; one deck for every mode (V42)

Mammon.text: At the end of each Day your Choir leans with the Tide, put 1 Glory from the Pot on this card. On your turn: You may take all the Glory on it, then discard this card.
Mammon.cadence: At the end of the Day

Lilith.text: Other players' abilities cannot look at, take, or discard cards in your hand.

Parasite.text: On your turn: Move this card into another player's Choir. Its holder cannot discard it.
Parasite.why: An attack, not a dead card (V42)

Winnowing.text: On your turn: Discard up to 2 facedown Altar cards without looking at them.
Winnowing.why: A blind strike at hidden Offers (V42)

Silence.text: On your turn: Choose a player. Their Choir's abilities do not work until your next turn.

Scapegoat.text: When another player would gain Glory at the Reaping, you may pay 1 Glory. They gain nothing.

Defiance.text: Other players' abilities cannot make you lose or give up Glory.

Bounty.text: In the Morning: You may name a player. At the end of the Day, if they lost Glory, gain 1 Glory. If they gained Glory, lose 1 Glory.
Bounty.why: One deck for every mode; a bet (V42)

Abaddon.text: On your turn: Replace every Altar card with the top card of the Host deck, then discard this card.

Vessel.text: On your turn: You may place a card from your hand on the Altar facedown (this is not an Offer). At the end of the Day, if it is still there, gain 1 Glory if it matches the Tide, or lose 1 if it opposes it.

Eternity.text: At the end of the Day: If you did not Offer this Day, gain 1 Glory.
Eternity.cadence: At the end of the Day

Raguel.text: When this enters your Choir, choose another player. They are Bound to you while it remains. At the end of the Day, if they gained Glory, gain 1 Glory. If they lost Glory, lose 1 Glory.

Twilight.text: At the end of the Day: If your Choir holds at least one Light and one Dark card, gain 1 Glory.
Twilight.cadence: At the end of the Day

Zealot.text: At the end of the Day: If every other card in your Choir (at least 3) shares one alignment, gain 1 Glory.
Zealot.cadence: At the end of the Day

Stillness.text: At the end of the Day: If the Tide was Neutral (a tie or an empty Altar), gain 1 Glory.
Stillness.cadence: At the end of the Day

Shroud.text: This card's alignment matches the previous Day's Tide: Light +1 after a Light Tide, Dark +1 after a Dark Tide. After a Neutral Tide, or on Day 1, it is Neutral.

Firmament.text: At the end of the Day: If the Tide won by exactly 1 and your Choir leans with it, gain 1 Glory.
Firmament.cadence: At the end of the Day

Moderation.text: At the end of the Day: If your Choir leans neither way, gain 1 Glory.
Moderation.cadence: At the end of the Day

Fig Leaves.text: On your turn: Your Choir sits out this Day. It gains nothing, loses nothing, and does not count as leaning either way.

Flaming Sword.text: On your turn: No other player may Exalt until the start of your next turn.

Outcast.text: At the end of the Day: If you have the least Glory (or are tied for it), gain 1 Glory.
Outcast.cadence: At the end of the Day
Outcast.why: Exalt is free, so only the catch-up remains (V42)

Heresy.text: On your turn: You may pay 1 Glory. Your Choir counts as leaning the opposite way this Day.
Heresy.why: Chosen before the reveal, for a price (V42)

Mirage.text: Your facedown Offerings cannot be flipped, looked at, exchanged, or destroyed before the Evening.

Veil.text: At the end of the Day: If more Altar cards were facedown than face up when it was revealed, gain 1 Glory.
Veil.cadence: At the end of the Day

Prophecy.text: In the Morning: Declare Light or Dark. At the end of the Day, if the Tide matches, gain 1 Glory; otherwise (a Neutral Tide included), lose 1 Glory.

Apple.text: At the end of the Day: If your Choir leans the other way from yesterday, gain 1 Glory.
Apple.cadence: At the end of the Day

Forger.text: When you Gather, you may take any Host card from the discard pile instead of a card from the Altar.
Forger.why: Gather takes from the Altar only (V42)

Ithuriel.text: On your turn: Flip one facedown card on the Altar face up.
Ithuriel.why: Retired: no art; ability moved to Revelation, Knowledge or Belial (V42)

Urim.text: On your turn: Secretly look at up to 3 facedown cards on the Altar.
Urim.why: Retired: no art; ability moved to Revelation, Knowledge or Belial (V42)

Asmadai.text: On your turn: Look at one facedown card on the Altar. You may exchange it with a card from your hand. The new card stays facedown.
Asmadai.why: Retired: no art; ability moved to Revelation, Knowledge or Belial (V42)
